The report states that schwa, turned a, turned v and alpha are used interchangeably and assumes no phonemic distinction among them\. Source IPA remains in Original/Phonemic while a dedicated display profile applies Jambu conventions\. Lexical\-similarity category numbers and letters are retained only in Notes and do not assert historical cognacy\. Printed source metadata provide localities and administrative units but no point coordinates, so the thirty dialect rows intentionally leave coordinates blank\.
